messages.content: Predict the participant’s own response in a one-shot anonymous public-good experiment. You start with 10 points. You and three other participants form a local group of 4. Allocate integer points from 0 to 10 to the local common pool and keep the rest privately. There is no global pool in this condition. The local group’s total contribution is multiplied by 2.4 and shared equally among the 4 members, including you. Your points earned equal the points you keep plus 0.6 times the total local contribution(including yours). All participants face the same rules. Groups are assigned randomly, without identifying descriptions or group-composition feedback. 40 points=1 GBP, in addition to a 0.50 GBP show-up fee. Personal attributes come only from this participant’s recorded profile; unavailable values are omitted. No other participant’s actual contribution or answer is supplied in this record. Now make your allocation. Output only a JSON object with integer fields "local", "private".
